text: DSH Theme Leshan 为 DSH Web 提供三款以乐山照片为背景的界面主题：三江夜、凌云晚照和峨眉夜雾。插件在网页端加入可收起的皮肤选择栏，支持点击选择或用 Alt+K 轮换，并分别适配浅色和深色外观。切换时会派生并应用完整的界面色彩 token，照片通过插件路由提供；没有主题服务时会使用样式表回退。适合想为 DSH 网页界面更换照片背景和整体配色的用户。代码未读取 API 密钥或调用外部服务。

DSH Theme Leshan adds three photo themes to DSH Web. Choose one in the skin rail or cycle with Alt+K. Each theme has light and dark palettes with matching interface colors. Wallpaper images are served locally, with a stylesheet fallback when the theme service is unavailable.

I want to switch my DSH web interface to a photo-based theme.
DSH Theme Leshan 的功能「照片皮肤切换」：在网页右下方皮肤栏选择三款乐山主题，也可按 Alt+K 轮换；选择结果保存在浏览器本地，界面同步切换对应照片和配色。
DSH Theme Leshan 的功能「双外观配色」：跟随 DSH 当前浅色或深色外观，为界面派生并应用对应色彩 token；无法取得主题服务时改用插件自己的样式表。

dsh-theme-leshan README · dsh-theme-leshan：Leshan is a small pack built around three photographs of 乐山: the rivers at blue hour, the Lingyun cliff at dusk, and Emei in night mist. Each photograph is the page; each skin declares six input colours per appearance; the engine derives the 119 `--dsw-*` alias tokens the Web shell reads from them, then measures the result. Three skins × two appearances = six palettes that all share the same semantic rules, so a state that reads in light mode reads in dark.

dsh-theme-leshan README · 乐山 · Leshan：The three photographs are used at their native resolution and cover-cropped by the shell. The host half serves them from `/dsh-theme-leshan/wallpapers/<file>` through an exact-file whitelist (immutable caching, HEAD, 304); without a `webServer` service the skin falls back to a wash and stays fully usable.

dsh-theme-leshan README · Switch skins：- Click the **Leshan** pill at the bottom-right of the window, or press <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd> to cycle.
- The choice is browser-local (`localStorage: dsh.theme.leshan.skin`), so different browsers can run different skins.
- “隐藏此钮” hides the pill (`dsh.theme.leshan.rail`); <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd> keeps working, and clearing that key brings the pill back.
- Light/dark still belongs to the shell’s own **Appearance** setting — Leshan has both palettes and never overrides your preference.

dsh-theme-leshan README · What it actually does：1. **Token layer.** On load it calls `ctx.theme.overrideTokens('dsh-theme-leshan', layer)`, where `layer` maps every `--dsw-*` alias token to a `{ light, dark }` pair. Switching a skin replaces that layer; unloading the plugin removes it. On a shell without the theme service it falls back to a scoped stylesheet with the same values.
2. **Wallpaper sheet.** One small plugin-owned stylesheet paints the active photograph on `<body>` *and* on the conversation column (`[data-conversation-region="chat"]`, the shell's reading surface, which otherwise sits on an opaque page-colour plate) under the same appearance-keyed scrim (0.86 → 0.90 light, 0.74 → 0.82 dark), keyed by `html[data-dsh-leshan]` / `html[data-dsh-leshan-wallpaper]`. Both seats share the focus, the `fixed` attachment and the scrim, so the photograph runs unbroken from the sidebar into the chat column; the derived surface tokens carry alpha so the panels read as frosted plates. No layout is touched.
3. **Skin rail.** A shadow-DOM panel so no shell rule can reach it, keyboard reachable, removed with the plugin.
dsh-theme-leshan README · What it actually does：Nothing else is written: no host settings document, no files, no network calls.

The three supplied PNG originals (`gpt-image-*.png`) stay in the package root as the wallpaper masters; `npm run compress` re-derives `assets/wallpapers/*.jpg` from them at quality 80.

dsh-theme-leshan README · Compatibility：- DeepSeek Harness Web **0.2.0-rc.1 … 0.2.x** (`dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client`).
- Works in the official Desktop app and in `dsh web`; needs a browser with `color-mix()` (Chromium 111+, Safari 16.2+).
- If the theme service is absent, the fallback layer still applies both palettes.

dsh-theme-leshan README · Develop：```sh
npm install
npm run verify   # build + token completeness + WCAG gates
npm run shots    # re-render every image at the documented size
```

dsh-theme-leshan README · Develop：Source layout: `src/color.mjs` (colour maths), `src/tokens.mjs` (the 119-name contract), `src/skins.mjs` (three skins, six inputs per appearance plus one photograph), `src/derive.mjs` (role derivation, plus the translucent-plate mode for photo skins), `src/runtime.mjs` (tokens, wallpaper, rail), `index.js` (the wallpaper route). `client.js` is generated — edit `src/` and run `npm run build`.

dsh-theme-leshan README · Develop：Adding a skin is one row in `src/skins.mjs` plus one JPEG in `assets/wallpapers/` and one entry in `index.js`'s whitelist; run `npm run verify` and the contrast gate tells you whether the two new palettes hold up.
